headerDisplay: Bridges INSNRG (Vi/Hub) pool equipment into HomeKit via the INSNRG cloud API. Use your insnrgapp.com login. In the INSNRG app, enable Voice Control under Connected Systems first.

email.title: INSNRG Email
email.description: The email you use to log in at insnrgapp.com.

password.title: INSNRG Password
password.description: Your insnrgapp.com password. Stored in your Homebridge config.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh state from the INSNRG cloud. Pool equipment changes slowly; 300s is a polite default for a cloud API (the Home Assistant reference polls every 900s). Minimum 60.

setpointMin.title: Heater Setpoint Minimum (°C)
setpointMin.description: Fallback lower limit for the pool/spa thermostat, used when the cloud reports an implausible range.

setpointMax.title: Heater Setpoint Maximum (°C)
setpointMax.description: Fallback upper limit for the pool/spa thermostat. Capped at 38 - Apple's HomeKit spec limit for thermostat targets.

exposeTimerSwitches.title: Expose Timer-mode switches
exposeTimerSwitches.description: Adds a second '<name> Timer' switch to each outlet/valve/contact that supports schedule (TimerOn) mode. On = device is running on its schedule.

exposeTimers.title: Expose the 4 schedule timers
exposeTimers.description: Exposes TIMER 1-4 enable switches (and chlorinator timer variants) as HomeKit switches. Off by default to reduce clutter.

exposeLightModes.title: Expose light colour-mode switches
exposeLightModes.description: Adds one switch per light colour mode (e.g. Ocean, Sunset) on the pool light accessory. Turning one on selects that mode.

exposeChemistrySensors.title: Expose pH / ORP sensors
exposeChemistrySensors.description: HomeKit has no pH or millivolt sensor type, so pH appears as a temperature sensor (reading = pH) and ORP as a light sensor (reading = mV). Disable if that bothers you.

exposeChlorinator.title: Expose chlorinator level
exposeChlorinator.description: Chlorinator output level as a stepped fan slider.

debug.title: Debug: log raw cloud responses
debug.description: Dumps the raw getall JSON to the Homebridge log each poll. Turn on when a value parses wrong so the raw payload can be diagnosed remotely.

heaterAutoPump.title: Heater auto-starts filter pump
heaterAutoPump.description: Gas heater ignition requires water flow. When on, switching the Gas Heater tile on will first turn the Filter Pump on if it isn't running.
